name: Dryad Pox
body:
Type disease (contact or injury); Save Fortitude DC 14

Onset 1 day; Frequency 1/day

Effect 1d2 Str damage, target must succeed a Will save DC 14 or be compelled to seek out and hug a tree for 10 minutes; Cure 2 consecutive saves
